{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"name":"python3","display_name":"Python 3","language":"python"},"language_info":{"name":"python"}},"nbformat_minor":4,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"cell_type":"markdown","source":"# V68 — Harvest Ledger — Remaining-Season Herd Value

DSM public replays motivated state-dependent production choices. Replace the inherited shop-name animal selector with remaining-season marginal value comparisons for cow/sheep purchases during days 6-20. Reuse the existing visible-herd and scheduled-supply model, zero future-unknown-shop demand, affordability checks, confirmed purchase credits and delivery rewrites. Require a gain buffer and 15 percent relative improvement. Geese are not substituted by this new selector; pasture compatibility is preserved. Existing earlier herd layers remain inherited, and forecast values are not guaranteed revenue.

These are local DSM-replay-inspired production experiments on a credited public controller, not copies of the private DSM agent. The new modules use observable state only. Settings were selected on screening seeds and evaluated on disjoint confirmation seeds. Shared source ancestry and limited seed coverage restrict conclusions. Local games do not predict Kaggle ratings.

Direct source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/tetsutani/demand-preserving-turn-sale-timing. Full author notices are retained in main.py and NOTICE.txt, with Apache-2.0 licensing. Public version numbering differs from this workspace.

Run both cells to create `submission.tar.gz` containing `main.py`, `LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` at archive root. Standard-library CPU only; no network or GPU is required. No local evaluation tests, DSM replay files, credentials or automatic submission are included. Inherited public prediction tables remain part of the credited controller.

with Path('submission.tar.gz').open('wb') as raw:
    with gzip.GzipFile(filename='', fileobj=raw, mode='wb', mtime=0) as zipped:
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=zipped, mode='w') as archive:
            for filename in FILES:

                assert hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() == EXPECTED[filename]

                member.size = len(content)
                member.mode = 0o644
                member.mtime = 0
                archive.addfile(member, io.BytesIO(content))
print('Created submission.tar.gz')

DSM public replays motivated state-dependent production choices. Replace the inherited shop-name animal selector with remaining-season marginal value comparisons for cow/sheep purchases during days 6-20. Reuse the existing visible-herd and scheduled-supply model, zero future-unknown-shop demand, affordability checks, confirmed purchase credits and delivery rewrites. Require a gain buffer and 15 percent relative improvement. Geese are not substituted by this new selector; pasture compatibility is preserved. Existing earlier herd layers remain inherited, and forecast values are not guaranteed revenue.

These are local DSM-replay-inspired production experiments on a credited public controller, not copies of the private DSM agent. The new modules use observable state only. Settings were selected on screening seeds and evaluated on disjoint confirmation seeds. Shared source ancestry and limited seed coverage restrict conclusions. Local games do not predict Kaggle ratings.

Direct source: https://www.kaggle.com/code/tetsutani/demand-preserving-turn-sale-timing. Full author notices are retained in main.py and NOTICE.txt, with Apache-2.0 licensing. Public version numbering differs from this workspace.

Run both cells to create `submission.tar.gz` containing `main.py`, `LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` at archive root. Standard-library CPU only; no network or GPU is required. No local evaluation tests, DSM replay files, credentials or automatic submission are included. Inherited public prediction tables remain part of the credited controller.
